fitted_on: one random race per athlete-season, all levels, prediction at level = college
response: log(outcome m/s); cs = critical speed, cs_minus = its lower bound (threshold), cs_plus = its upper bound (VO2max pace)
evaluation: Each parameter is a piecewise bicubic polynomial in (x = log10 distance_m, t = log10 time_s). Find the cell: ix = last index with x_breaks[ix] <= x (clamped to the first/last cell, extend the edge cell's polynomial outside the domain), same for t. u = (x - x_breaks[ix]) / (x_breaks[ix+1] - x_breaks[ix]), v likewise. value = sum_{i,j=0..3} coef[ix][it][4*i + j] * u^i * v^j.
quantile: sigma = exp(log_sigma) + sigma_floor; delta = exp(log_delta); q_p = mu + sigma * delta * sinh((asinh(z_p) + eps) / delta); speed_m_s = exp(q_p)
spread_clamp: mu is evaluated at the true (x, t). log_sigma, eps and log_delta are evaluated at the point clamped into the data hull: x clamped to [log10 800, log10 10000], then t clamped to [log10 hull_fast(x), log10 hull_slow(x)] where the hull edges are interpolated linearly in log-log between the vertices and held constant beyond 800 m / 10 km.

hull.note: inside = 800 <= distance <= 10000 and fast_s(d) <= time <= slow_s(d); outside is extrapolated and should be labelled
